items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: Well, no more than Joe Petit and Frankie Deucon.

ctx.x: Did most of the fellas play slide when you came up? You don't remember many of the vowels.
Well, no more than Joe Petit and Frankie Deucon.
Do you remember Willie Carnage? Did he play slide or vowel or what?
